excerpts.locator: Global oil markets: estimated production shut-ins paragraph
excerpts.quote: We assess that crude oil production shut-ins averaged 6.7 million barrels per day (b/d) in August, up from 5.0 million b/d in July.
The Brent crude oil spot price increased to an average of $91 per barrel (b) in August, $7/b higher than in July.

excerpts.locator: Conditional expected oil-flow restoration and forecast prices paragraph
excerpts.quote: As exports from the Middle East gradually increase and shut-in oil production restarts, we forecast oil prices will begin to fall, decreasing to an average of $77/b by 2Q27.
